description: This PHP script acts as a client for testing remote execution of test cases via XML-RPC. It constructs various argument sets to execute different test scenarios on a remote server and displays server responses.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: External XML-RPC client class used to communicate with the remote server.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC request to execute a method with given parameters.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the response from the XML-RPC request.
